title: Inventory
subtitle: The school store: items, stock, requests and counts

items.searchPlaceholder: Search items by name or code…
items.name: Item
items.reorderHelp: Alert the store when stock falls to this level. Leave empty for no alert.
items.assetHelp: Assets are durable property (desks, projectors) — register each unit in the Assets tab to tag-track its custody.
items.deleteBody: Only items with no ledger history can be deleted — otherwise deactivate them.
items.emptyBody: Start your catalog: add the things your store keeps — chalk, paper, desks, lab kits.
items.assetToggleHelp: Durable property (projectors, desks) — each unit gets its own tag and custody trail.
items.unitsSectionHelp: Each unit gets a tag code to write on it. Units also land on the stock ledger — one save, both books.
items.openingSectionHelp: Optional — leave the quantity empty to add a catalog row only.

categories.title: Item categories
categories.subtitle: Platform categories are shared; add your school's own below.
categories.name: Category name
categories.deleteBody: Categories with items cannot be deleted — deactivate them instead.

movement.emptyBody: Every receive, issue and adjustment lands here — the store's bin card.
movement.adjustHelp: Use a positive number for found surplus, a negative number for shrinkage.

requisitions.cartEmpty: Nothing picked yet — search the catalog and tap items to add them.
requisitions.approveHelp: You can trim quantities before approving.
requisitions.issueHelp: Enter what is leaving the store now — partial issues are fine.
requisitions.nothingToIssue: Nothing left to issue on this request.
requisitions.cancelBody: The store will not see it anymore.
requisitions.ownRowNote: You filed this request — a different approver must decide it.
requisitions.emptyBody: Staff requests for store items appear here.
requisitions.emptyMine: You have not requested anything yet
requisitions.emptyMineBody: Need chalk, paper or equipment? Request it from the store and track it here.

po.optionalNote: Purchase orders are optional — you can always receive stock directly.
po.receiveHelp: Enter what actually arrived — part deliveries are fine.
po.cancelBody: Orders with received goods cannot be cancelled.
po.ownRowNote: You raised this order — a different approver must decide it.
po.emptyBody: Raise one when you order from a supplier — or skip them and receive stock directly.

stockTakes.newHelp: Counting freezes nothing — the store keeps working. Differences post to the ledger only when you finish.
stockTakes.notCounted: Skipped lines keep their current stock.
stockTakes.postBody: Each counted difference posts to the ledger as an adjustment. Uncounted items stay untouched.
stockTakes.cancelBody: Saved tallies are discarded; stock stays as it is.
stockTakes.emptyBody: Run one each semester: count the store, post the differences, keep the books honest.

noAccess: You do not have access to the inventory module in this workspace.

assets.searchPlaceholder: Search by tag, serial or item…
assets.registerHelp: Each unit gets its own tag — write it on the item. The register tracks identity; quantities stay on the stock ledger.
assets.markLostBody: Any custody is closed and the unit leaves the working fleet. If it turns up, you can bring it back to the store.
assets.disposeBody: Disposal is final — the unit stays in the register as history but can never return.
assets.deleteBody: Only units that never held custody can be deleted — otherwise dispose of them.
assets.emptyBody: Register your durable property — projectors, desks, lab kits — and every unit gets a tag and a custody trail.
assets.emptyForItem: No units registered yet — register them to start the custody trail.

textbooks.issueHelp: Every active student in the section gets one copy; students who already hold this book are skipped automatically.
textbooks.lostBody: The family will be notified. No stock changes — the copy left the shelf when it was issued.
textbooks.emptyBody: Issue MoE textbooks to a section at year start; collect them here at year end.

bulk.returnDesc: Stock goes back up by the number of copies collected. Books already returned or lost are skipped.
bulk.noneOut: None of the selected books are still with a student.

overview.setupTitle: Set up your store in one step
overview.setupBody: Everything starts from the item catalog. Adding an item also puts its stock on the shelf — one form, no extra steps.
overview.setupStep1: Add the things your store keeps — chalk, paper, desks, lab kits — with their opening quantities.
overview.setupStep2: Durable property? Flip the asset toggle in the same form and the units are tagged automatically.
overview.setupStep3: Done — staff can request items, and you receive, issue and count from here.
overview.addHint: New item + stock in one go
overview.whoHoldsBody: Pick a person, room or section to see every asset unit still in their hands — the clearance check.
overview.holdsNothing: Nothing in their hands — all clear.
